name: Google

rate_limit.source: No published limit for the results page; kept to a person's pace.

license_note: Google's results page for simple phones, fetched with the legacy_mobile client (the browser-like client the page answers; request shape observed black-box from SearXNG's network traffic, no SearXNG code read). Titles, links and snippets only. An "unusual traffic" answer suspends the engine; it is never solved or worked around. Google's terms do not allow automated queries: the highest terms risk of the results-page engines (ADR 0002 §6 as amended; OCTOS_ALLOW_SERP_SCRAPE=0 turns results-page search off).
